name: SnapDock
summary: A frosted dock and Windows-style window tools for Omarchy: snapping, Snap Assist, minimize and move to desktop
description:
New in 0.8.0: SnapDock's own dock, Show desktop (Super + D), title bars on browsers. Full list under What's New below.

SnapDock gives Omarchy a beautiful frosted glass dock, and makes your desktop feel instantly familiar if you're coming from Windows or macOS.

A DOCK MADE OF GLASS
SnapDock’s own frosted glass dock floats at the bottom of your screen and blurs whatever is behind it, like the dock on a Mac. Click an app to open it, click again to minimize it, and right-click for its windows, snap layouts, move to desktop, maximize and close. Point at an icon to see its name; dots show how many windows are open. Choose Small, Medium or Large, or let it auto-hide like a Mac. It recolours itself every time you switch Omarchy themes. Or choose your own: theme, theme accent, theme dark, black, white or any colour code, with four glass levels from solid to strong. Running apps get a little dot. The dock is set up for you the first time, with your files, terminal and browser pinned and only apps you actually have.

PIN WHAT YOU USE
Pin and unpin apps from SnapDock's menu: it lists every app on your computer. Built-in buttons include Reboot (asks first, so no accidents), Screenshot and Settings, plus an all-apps button that opens Omarchy's app list. Turn the dock off and on any time.

SNAP LIKE WINDOWS
Arrange windows exactly like Windows 11:
• Super + arrow keys: left or right half, then the same arrow again for a quarter, up to fill the screen, down to put it back (or, on a window that isn't snapped, minimize it).
• Drag a window to a screen edge for half, a corner for a quarter, or the top to fill. A see-through preview shows where it will land.
• Super + Z, or the ⊞ button on any title bar, shows every layout: halves, quarters, thirds, two-thirds, fill and centre.

MINIMIZE, LIKE WINDOWS
Click — on any title bar, or press Super + Down, and the window gets out of the way while its icon stays in the dock. Click the icon and it comes back exactly where it was, on the desktop it came from. Bring every minimized window back at once from SnapDock's menu.

MOVE WINDOWS BETWEEN DESKTOPS
The numbers 1 2 3 4 5 at the top left of Omarchy are separate desktops. Send a window to one in a click: press ⧉ on its title bar and pick a number. Or drag the window toward the top left corner: numbered tiles appear, and dropping it on one moves it there, same size, while you stay where you are.

SHOW DESKTOP
The last button on the dock, or Super + D, sends every window on the desktop down into the dock so you see your background. Press again and they all come back.

SNAP ASSIST
Snap one window and SnapDock offers your other open windows to fill the space that's left. Click one and your side-by-side layout is done.

SMART TITLE BARS
With Omarchy's title bars on, every window, browsers included, gets desktops ⧉, snap ⊞, minimize — and maximize □ buttons next to close. Double-click a title bar to maximize or restore. The buttons follow your theme colours.

RESIZE FROM ANY EDGE
Grab any window edge with the mouse and drag to resize it, snapped windows included.

SCREENSHOTS IN ONE CLICK
Tap the camera on the dock or press Shift + Print. The whole screen is copied to your clipboard and saved in Pictures.

YOUR SETUP, ALWAYS SAFE
Before SnapDock changes anything, it saves your current desktop settings to a backup file in your Downloads folder. Save a new backup any time, and restore any backup from the menu. Uninstalling offers to put back your exact setup from before SnapDock.

FIXES ITSELF
"Check for problems" finds the usual conflicts (two docks, settings errors, missing parts), saves a report you can send for help, and repairs SnapDock in one click.

SPEAKS YOUR LANGUAGE
SnapDock is in 33 languages and follows your computer's language automatically. Pick another one any time from its menu.

MADE FOR OMARCHY
Everything lives in Omarchy's own menu style and theme colours. Updates show up in the Omarchy Store's Updates tab and inside SnapDock.

FREE FOR A LIMITED TIME. UPDATES FOR LIFE FOR EARLY ADOPTERS
SnapDock is free right now, but only for a limited time: it becomes a paid app after launch. Get it while it's free and you're an early adopter, with every future update included at no cost, for life.

steps.title: Install it
steps.body: Press GET in the Omarchy Store app, or use one of the install options above. Type your password when asked.

steps.title: Open SnapDock
steps.body: Press Super + Space, type SnapDock, press Enter. It saves a backup of your setup to Downloads, then sets up your dock and shortcuts.

steps.title: Make it yours
steps.body: Choose the dock's colour and glass, pin your favourite apps, and turn features on or off.

faq.a: Right now, yes, for a limited time. SnapDock becomes a paid app after launch. Everyone who gets it while it's free is an early adopter and gets every future update free, for life.

faq.q: Does it work with my theme?
faq.a: Yes. The dock and title bars recolour themselves whenever you switch Omarchy themes.

faq.q: Will it mess up my setup?
faq.a: No. The first time it opens, SnapDock saves your current desktop settings (window settings, dock, top bar, launcher and app shortcuts) to a backup file in your Downloads folder. It replaces your current dock and adjusts your window settings, and you can put everything back any time: SnapDock menu → Backup & restore → Restore a backup.

faq.q: Where does a minimized window go?
faq.a: It waits out of sight, and its icon stays in the dock. Click the icon and it comes back on the desktop it came from, in the same spot. To bring every minimized window back at once: SnapDock → Snap layouts → Bring back all minimized windows.

The numbers at the top left of Omarchy are separate desktops, each with its own windows (like Task View desktops on Windows). Click a number to switch to it. SnapDock lets you send a window to one: ⧉ on the title bar, or drag the window onto the tiles that appear at the top left.
In your Downloads folder, named SnapDock-Backup-Before-SnapDock-<date>.tar.gz. Keep it somewhere safe. It works even without SnapDock: the file explains the one command that puts it back.

faq.q: Something isn't working. What do I do?
faq.a: Open SnapDock and choose Check for problems. It finds the usual causes (two docks running, a settings error, a missing part), saves a report in Downloads you can send for help, and offers Repair.
The Omarchy Store's Updates tab shows new versions: press UPDATE. SnapDock also tells you when one is ready (SnapDock → Update).
Open SnapDock → Uninstall → "Uninstall and put back my setup from before SnapDock". Then remove the program: omarchy pkg remove snapdock
A recent Omarchy (version 4 or newer). On older versions SnapDock tells you to update Omarchy first and changes nothing.

featured.new_line: New in 0.8.0: SnapDock’s own dock · Show desktop · Title bars on browsers

changelog.title: SnapDock’s own dock, Show desktop, title bars on browsers
items: A new dock, made by SnapDock (the old nwg-dock is no longer needed). Click an app: it opens. Click again while it’s in front: it minimizes. Click a minimized app: it comes straight back.
Apps with several windows: a click shows the list; if they’re all minimized, one click brings them all back. App names appear when you point at an icon, and dots show how many windows are open.
Right-click menu on every dock icon: its windows, New window, Minimize / Bring back, Maximize, Snap layouts, Move to desktop 1–5, Keep in dock / Remove from dock, Close.
Show desktop: the last button on the dock, or Super + D, sends every window on the desktop into the dock. Press again and they all come back.
Dock size: Small, Medium or Large (SnapDock → Dock → Size).
Auto-hide, like a Mac: the dock slides away and returns when the mouse touches the bottom of the screen; windows then use the whole screen (SnapDock → Dock → Auto-hide).
Browsers get the title bar too (Chromium, Firefox, Brave…) with ⧉ ⊞ — □ ✕. Turn it off in SnapDock → Title bars.
Fixed: Chromium pinned under a broken name by the old dock.
All new texts in the 33 languages.

changelog.title: Minimize and move to desktop
items: Minimize, like Windows: a new — button on every title bar hides the window. Its icon stays in the dock; click it and the window comes back exactly where it was, on the desktop it came from.
Super + Down minimizes a window that isn't snapped, just like Win + Down. On a snapped window it first puts it back the way it was; press it again to minimize.
Move a window to another desktop (the 1 2 3 4 5 at the top left) with the new ⧉ title bar button: click a number in the little card, or just type it.
Or drag a window toward the top left corner: numbered tiles appear under the desktop numbers. Let go over one and the window moves there, keeping its size. You stay where you are.
New in the menu: SnapDock → Snap layouts → Bring back all minimized windows.
Title bar, left to right: ⧉ desktops · ⊞ snap layouts · — minimize · □ maximize · ✕ close. SnapDock → Title bars turns them on or off.
Uninstall puts minimized windows back on their desktops first, so nothing stays hidden.
All new texts are translated into the 33 languages.
The Omarchy Store app now always recognises SnapDock, even if you installed it with the installer file, so it shows UPDATE and Remove for it.

changelog.title: SnapDock speaks your language
items: 33 languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Swedish, Danish, Norwegian, Finnish, Icelandic, Turkish, Greek, Hungarian, Lithuanian, Irish, Catalan, Bosnian, Arabic, Urdu, Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Sinhala, Thai, Vietnamese, Filipino, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese and Uzbek.
Follows your computer's language automatically. Pick another one: SnapDock → Language.
Menus, messages, notifications, the snap layout picker, key names in Omarchy's key list, the backup note and the app launchers are all translated.
Your choice is kept after updates.

changelog.title: Backups and Check for problems
items: Before SnapDock changes anything, it saves your desktop settings to a backup file in Downloads.
Backup & restore menu: save your settings any time, and put any backup back.
Uninstall can put back your exact setup from before SnapDock.
Check for problems finds conflicts (two docks, settings errors, missing parts), saves a report and can repair.
Older Omarchy versions get a clear message instead of a half setup.

changelog.title: Windows-style snapping
items: Super + arrow keys snap like Win + arrows.
Drag a window to an edge or corner to snap it, with a see-through preview.
Snap layouts (Super + Z or ⊞ on the title bar) and Snap Assist.
